# tstest

Checks the TypeScript clients generated by `genclient` with a pinned
TypeScript toolchain.

- `npm run typecheck`: type-checks every `../gendoctest*/client.ts` golden
  (`tsconfig.golden.json`, browser libs, `strict` + `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`).
- `npm run test:runtime`: builds `src/**/*.test.ts` (`tsconfig.json`) and runs
  them with `node --test`.
- `npm run check`: both.

From the repository root:

```sh
(cd genclient/testdata/tstest && npm ci)
go test -tags tsintegration ./genclient/
```

This directory lives under `testdata` so that `go test ./...` never walks
`node_modules`.
